st: The Night Of The Two-Legged Buffalo
d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon are assigned to protect South Seas island prince who insists on going to an exclusive health resort where assassins are waiting to kill him.

st: The Night Of The Druid's Blood
d: Secret agent James T. West, probing the murder by fire of one of his former professors, Dr. Robey, a distinguished archaeologist, is ordered off the case at the request of U.S. Senator Hungerford.
Posing as a notorious hired gunman and a corrupt colonel, secret agents James T.West and Artemus Gordon infiltrate the forces of renegade-army leader Thorald Wolfe.

st: The Night Of The Burning Diamond
d: Secret agent James T. West is asking the Serbian minister to place his country's fabulous Kara diamond in federal custody until the International Jewel Exhibit opens, when suddenly the gem's case explodes and the jewel disappears.

st: The Night Of The Murderous Spring
d: A tall, powerfully built girl, Kitten Twitty, registers at a hotel and secret agent James T. West carries her trunk to her room, not knowing it contains his archenemy—diminutive, giggling Dr. Loveless.

st: The Night Of The Sudden Plague
d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon find the town of Willow Springs looted and its citizens completely immobile -- victims of a mysterious paralysis.
Secret agent, James T. West, investigating the murder of a fellow agent, discovers a plot to assassinate the President of Mexico.

st: The Night Of The Golden Cobra
d: A self-styled maharajah kidnaps secret agent James T. West and holds him captive in his palace.
Agents West and Gordon again face Dr. Loveless whom, planning to rule a world of "little people," reduces West to a six-inch miniature.

st: The Night Of The Big Blast
d: A mad woman scientist creates a bomb-carrying robot identical to agent Westand orders it to kill members of the President's cabinet.

st: The Night Of The Returning Dead
d: Agents West and Gordon employ the services of a man who possesses a power of concentration that controls animals.

st: The Night Of The Flying Pie Plate
d: Agent West gets involved in a bizarre extortion scheme involving green "Venusians" who claim they need gold for spaceship fuel.

st: The Night Of The Poisonous Posey
d: Agents West and Gordon visit a town named Justice during Law and Order Seek and find it the site for a convention of criminals.

st: The Night Of The Bottomless Pit
d: Secret agents James T. West and Artemus Gordon are assigned to free a fellow agent from Devil's Island.

st: The Night Of The Watery Death
d: Secret agent West is kidnapped by a madman who plans to create an underwater kingdom that will control the world's shipping lanes.

st: The Night Of The Green Terror
d: The evil, diminutive Dr. Loveless impoverishes an Indian tribe so that he can become their benefactor -- and their god.
Secret agent, James T. West, investigating the murder of a fellow agent, discovers a plot to assassinate the President of Mexico.
